assumption: Discovery works through existing conventions: llms.txt as a site's index of Markdown pages, RSS 2.0 feeds (via the source field) and OPML, without a new protocol.
evidence: INT-001: Dirk Primbs uses llms.txt for this; Winer says the work will 'work extremely well with RSS 2.0 and OPML'. Neither is yet specified for this use.
test_method: Spike: open an llms.txt as a navigable index and a source feed as a list of posts; see whether they lead to readable .md pages.
